sources.title: Real-Time AI-Driven Milling Digital Twin Towards Extreme Low-Latency
sources.summary_ru: (d1) Рассматривается цифровой двойник для фрезерования с использованием искусственного интеллекта и машинного обучения для создания модели взаимодействия инструмента и заготовки в реальном времени.
sources.snippet: Digital twin (DT) enables smart manufacturing by leveraging real-time data, AI models, and intelligent control systems. This paper presents a state-of-the-art analysis on the emerging field of DTs in the context of milling. The critical aspects of DT are explored through the lens of virtual models of physical milling, data flow from physical milling to virtual model, and feedback from virtual model to physical milling. Live data streaming protocols and virtual modeling methods are highlighted.

sources.title: Cyber-Physical Digital Factory Architecture as the Enabler of Disembodied Work
sources.summary_ru: (d2) Описана архитектура киберфизического цифрового завода, объединяющая цифровые двойники, иерархический ИИ, промышленный интернет вещей и интерфейсы расширенной реальности для удалённого управления производством.
sources.snippet: This paper proposes a cyber-physical digital factory architecture that enables disembodied work, where manufacturing systems can be supervised and operated remotely through eXtended Reality (XR) user interfaces in collaboration between AI-based control and human operators. The architecture integrates synchronized DTs, hierarchical cloud-edge AI, IIoT, and XR teleoperation interfaces into a cyber-physical manufacturing environment.

sources.title: Agentic AI-enabled Semantic Commissioning of a Cognitive Digital Twin for Reconfigurable Manufacturing
sources.summary_ru: (d3) Представлена агентно-ориентированная система на базе искусственного интеллекта для автоматической настройки когнитивного цифрового двойника в адаптивном производстве, ускоряющая цикл запуска с недель до часов.
sources.snippet: Rapid bespoke commissioning of the Cognitive Digital Twin (CDT) is a major challenge in reconfigurable manufacturing. Traditional digital twin (DT) construction methods primarily focus on geometric reconstruction, often neglecting the deep semantic integration and functional interoperability necessary for autonomous reasoning. This paper proposes an agent-based, AI-driven workflow to automate end-to-end CDT debugging.

sources.summary_ru: Статья описывает метод бескадрового обнаружения аномалий на промышленных линиях с использованием геометрии коллапса нейронов и синтетических аномалий для повышения стабильности признаков.
sources.snippet: To address this limitation, we formulate industrial anomaly detection as a task-free continual learning problem and propose NC-TFAD, a neural-collapse-inspired, geometry-driven framework for learning from non-stationary data streams without task boundaries. sources.title: PolyUMI: Accessible Visual-Tactile-Audio Data Collection for Object Inference and Manipulation
sources.summary_ru: (d1) Описана платформа PolyUMI для сбора мультимодальных данных (визуальных, тактильных, звуковых) и обучения роботов выполнению сложных манипуляций с учётом контакта.
sources.snippet: Humans typically rely on vision, touch, hearing, and proprioception to perceive contact and adapt their actions during manipulation. Providing robots with comparable responsiveness therefore requires hardware that can retain and use these complementary sensory signals. Most imitation-learning systems, however, observe demonstrations primarily through vision and proprioception, limiting access to contact information that is difficult to infer visually. We present PolyUMI, an open-source platform for scalable visual--tactile--audio demonstration collection and robot deployment.

sources.title: Online Multimodal Workload Assessment in Contact-Rich Physical Human-Robot Interaction
sources.summary_ru: (d3) Разработан онлайновый фреймворк для непрерывной оценки физической нагрузки человека в процессе взаимодействия с роботом, учитывающий кинематику и физиологические показатели.
sources.snippet: Contact-rich physical human--robot interaction (pHRI) imposes time-varying demands associated with physical interaction, motor regulation, and physiological response, motivating continuous assessment of interaction workload. This paper presents an online multimodal assessment framework that integrates interaction wrench, planar tool-center-point (TCP) kinematics, and skin conductance level (SCL) into four interpretable workload-related factors.

sources.title: Phrase-Level Robotic Guqin Performance: Bimanual Motion Planning and Audio-Tactile Interaction Monitoring
sources.summary_ru: (d4) Создана физическая двухпальцевая роботизированная система для автономного исполнения музыкальных фраз на китайском инструменте гуцинь с точностью 93,6–96,8%.
sources.snippet: Recent advances in humanoid robotics and embodied intelligence have enabled robots to perform increasingly complex manipulation tasks. However, musical instrument performance remains a formidable benchmark, demanding not only collision-free trajectory execution but also precise contact timing, asymmetric bimanual coordination, and target acoustic outcomes on physical instruments. The guqin, a seven-string fretless zither, presents unique manipulation challenges due to its millimetric string spacing, transient right-hand plucking, and sustained left-hand harmonic contacts.

sources.title: ULOHA: An Underwater Bimanual Robot System for Robot Learning
sources.summary_ru: (d1) Описана платформа ULOHA для обучения двусторонним манипуляциям под водой, включающая аппаратуру лидер-последователь и программное расширение LeRobot. Исследованы методики переноса навыков между воздушной и водной средой.
sources.snippet: We present ULOHA, an underwater bimanual robot learning platform that combines custom-designed leader--follower hardware with software extensions to LeRobot, integrating teleoperation, multi-view sensing, demonstration collection, policy training, and autonomous deployment. Real-robot experiments demonstrate a range of coordinated underwater bimanual behaviors, including inter-arm transfer, shared-object manipulation, and buoyancy-driven interception. We evaluate ACT, Diffusion Policy, and the vision--language--action model SmolVLA on the platform.

sources.title: ViLoMan: Learning Visual-Proprioceptive Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation Skills for Humanoid Robots
sources.summary_ru: (d2) Представлена система ViLoMan для обучения гуманоидов визуально-проприоцептивной локомоции и манипуляции. Использован фреймворк учитель-студент для преобразования частичных демонстраций человека в полные траектории робота.
sources.snippet: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires adaptive whole-body coordination to seamlessly integrate locomotion and physical interaction. Despite recent advances, learning autonomous loco-manipulation remains challenging due to the scarcity of diverse, physically executable robot-object interaction data and the difficulty of learning unified whole-body control directly from onboard observations. We present ViLoMan, a scalable framework for autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation.

sources.title: RegenHarness: A Robot Agent Harness with Evidence-Gated Recursive Self-Improvement
sources.summary_ru: (d2) Представлена система RegenHarness с рекурсивным самоулучшением и контролем достоверности для долгосрочных задач робототехники.
sources.snippet: To our knowledge, we are the first to introduce an evidence-gated recursive self-improvement (RSI) protocol for embodied robotic agents. Across missions, execution records motivate candidate changes to context rules, task templates, routing, and recovery policies; fixed regression checks and release authorization govern their acceptance; versioned rollout and rollback preserve configuration traceability. This RSI protocol revises the harness configuration without online model-weight updates or permission to weaken the commit gate.

sources.title: HarnessPAI: An Evolving Harness for Physical AI
sources.summary_ru: (d3) Описан подход HarnessPAI, позволяющий эволюционировать программы физических агентов без переобучения базовых моделей, с улучшением производительности на различных платформах.
sources.snippet: Physical AI aims to build embodied agents that perceive the world, understand and reason about it, and decide how to act. Yet the field has focused primarily on the last component: the action model that maps observations to low-level controls. The prevailing training recipe can erode the perceptual and reasoning capabilities needed for robust behavior, leaving even strong action models vulnerable to scene perturbations and long-horizon tasks.

sources.summary_ru: (d2) Предлагается система Lizard для адаптивной передачи видеопотока через крайние маршрутизаторы, использующая отбрасывание менее значимых пакетов для снижения задержки и повышения точности аналитики.
sources.snippet: The timeliness and accuracy of edge-based video analytics can be hindered by drastic reductions in available bandwidth (ABW) at last-mile edge routers, causing prolonged queuing delays. This work proposes Lizard, a system that leverages video-content-aware packet discarding to mitigate the negative effects of drastic ABW degradation that may frequently occur at a last-mile edge router by judiciously discarding packets that contain frame blocks less important to the analytics at the destination.

sources.title: Latency and Privacy-Aware Resource Allocation in Vehicular Edge Computing

sources.snippet: Neglecting the management of processing resources in vehicular edge computing (VEC) could lead to numerous challenges as a substantial number of vehicles with diverse safety, economic, and entertainment applications, along with their data processing, emerge in the near future [1]. Previous research in VEC resource allocation has primarily focused on issues such as response time and privacy preservation techniques. However, an approach that takes into account privacy-aware resource allocation based on vehicular network architecture and application requirements has not yet been proposed.

sources.snippet: Physical AI at the edge -- enabling autonomous systems to understand and predict real-world dynamics in real time -- requires hardware-efficient learning and inference. sources.summary_ru: (d1) Описана платформа FREDI для безопасного распределённого инференса на границе сети с использованием двойных порогов уверенности и совместного распределения ресурсов.
sources.snippet: FREDI decomposes the problem into proportional-fair resource allocation and dual-threshold inference optimization. We prove that the detected-critical event set is set-monotone non-increasing in both thresholds, and exploit the finite empirical confidence domain for exact threshold optimization. An empirical resource--utility response envelope yields a computable global suboptimality bound and a sufficient condition for global optimality.

sources.snippet: In this paper, we explore the problem of reliability-ensured personalized function scheduling (REPFS) to jointly optimize the profit of service providers and the holistic QoE of end users in sustainable serverless edge computing. A personality-driven user QoE prediction method is first designed to accurately estimate the QoE of individual end users with differentiated personality types. Afterward, a deterministic function scheduling policy is developed on the problem-specific augmented non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm II (PSA-NSGA-II).

sources.snippet: However, the dynamic and constrained nature of edge environments makes hyperparameter optimization (HPO) for Machine Learning (ML) models particularly challenging, as it must balance predictive accuracy with training cost, energy efficiency, and stability. In this work, we propose MODE, a Multi-Objective HyperParameter Optimization (MOHPO) scheme tailored for efficient edge-based training. sources.snippet: While MNOs control network-side feasibility and ECSPs expose candidate edge environments, the ASP must decide where deployment is viable across regions, operators, and service requirements. Existing standards, including 3GPP NEF, CAPIF, EDGEAPP, ETSI MEC, and GSMA Open Gateway/CAMARA, provide important mechanisms for API exposure, runtime traffic steering, edge service discovery, and endpoint selection. However, they do not provide a standardized way for ASPs or authorized aggregators to evaluate deployment feasibility before infrastructure is placed.
